name: Dynamic QR Code Block
author: SH Sajal Chowdhury

sections.description:
Dynamic QR Code Block allows you to easily create and customize QR codes within the WordPress block editor. Perfect for sharing links, contact information, or any text content in a visually appealing QR code format.

Features

  • Easy-to-use Gutenberg block interface
  • Customize QR code size and margin
  • Choose custom colors for foreground and background
  • Multiple error correction levels (L: 7%, M: 15%, Q: 25%, H: 30%)
  • Live preview in the editor
  • Responsive design
  • Clean and modern UI
  • SVG output for crisp display
  • Support for various content types:
    • URLs
    • Plain text
    • Email addresses
    • Phone numbers
    • SMS messages
    • WhatsApp messages

Use Cases

  • Add QR codes to your business website for easy contact sharing
  • Create scannable links for your product pages
  • Generate QR codes for event tickets or registration
  • Add digital business cards to your about page
  • Create scannable menu links for restaurants

Usage

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Add the “Dynamic QR Code” block to your post or page
  3. Enter the content you want to encode
  4. Customize the appearance using the block settings:
    • Adjust size and margins
    • Choose colors
    • Select error correction level
    • Configure content type-specific options
  5. Preview your QR code in real-time
  6. Save and publish!

External Services

  • The API is used only in the WordPress admin area for previewing QR codes while editing.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/dynamic-qr-code-block directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Add the QR Code block to your posts or pages
sections.faq:
What error correction levels are available?

We support four error correction levels:
* Low (7%)
* Medium (15%)
* Quartile (25%)
* High (30%)

Is the plugin compatible with the latest WordPress version?

Yes, we regularly test and update the plugin to ensure compatibility with the latest WordPress version.
